description: Bare-name lexical walk-up resolution: own children first, then each ancestor's children one scope at a time, first match wins (CORE_MODEL_SPEC §3.2, §3.7).

cases.name: bare name resolves to own child first
cases.note: Walk-up searches the caller's OWN children first; Income has child Sales.

cases.name: bare name resolves to a sibling (parent scope)
cases.note: Income has no child Margin; next scope is Q1's children, where Margin (sibling of Income) matches.

cases.name: bare name resolves at a deeper enclosing scope
cases.note: Sales has no child Margin; Income has none; Q1's children include Margin. Q1 is Ancestor(2) of Sales.

cases.name: an ancestor is findable by its own name
cases.note: Walk-up reaches 2005's children, which include Q1. 2005 is Ancestor(3) of Sales. (§3.2 consequence bullet.)

cases.name: bare descent: sibling then its child
cases.note: Q1 resolves by walk-up (sibling of Total under 2005); then descend into child Margin.

cases.name: no scope matches → Unresolved
cases.note: No node named Nonexistent in any enclosing scope up to root.

cases.name: self-reference resolves to self and cycles
cases.note: A node's formula naming its own name resolves to self; under the default profile evaluation produces a circular-reference error (§3.2). Cycle handling across profiles is covered by the cycles/ theme (§7a).
